name: LUMINO INDUSTRIES LIMITED
summary: Lumino Industries Limited manufactures and sells conductors, power cables, electrical wires, and other products and components for power distribution and transmission industries in India and internationally. It offers aluminium conductors; LV XLPE/PVC insulated power, LV XLPE/PVC insulated control, LV aerial bunch, railway signalling, concentric, screened and instrumentation, solar, LV FR/FRLSH/FR-LSZH fire performance, underwriters laboratories, quad, medium voltage cross linked cables, as well as MV overhead covered conductors and electrical wires; and thermoset insulated, single-core service, and house wires.
